explanation_full: Based on the combined feature analysis (Figure 3), the feature importance ranking indicates that VSS has the highest importance score (0.5052), followed by Acetate (0.12) and Butyrate (0.097). For feature ranking (GRA), VFA (0.7931) is ranked highest, followed by Butyrate (0.7902), and Acetate (0.7772). In terms of correlation, the strongest relationships identified are: Butyrate vs VFA (0.9601), Acetate vs VFA (0.9428), and Acetate vs Butyrate (0.8651). Furthermore, the incremental feature selection process showed that the best performance (R2=0.8301) was achieved by KNN using 9 features (VFA -> Butyrate -> Acetate -> VSS -> Propionate -> Ethanol -> COD-O -> pH -> ORP_Low).
